description: This source file implements functions related to object creation and removal within the Ansc Object Descriptor framework, specifically for the Service Creation Environment Container (SCEC). It defines two main functions: AnscOdoCreateObject, which creates a new object using a function pointer within the descriptor, and AnscOdoRemoveObject, which removes an existing object via a function pointer. The file includes licensing information, module description, and function documentation.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscOdoCreateObject(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext)
methods.description: Creates a new object by invoking the create function pointer stored within the object descriptor, passing container and owner contexts along with mapper reservation handle. Returns a handle to the created object or NULL if creation function is not set.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscOdoRemoveObject(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hObject)
methods.description: Removes an object by calling the remove function pointer stored within the object descriptor. Returns status indicating success or unapplicability.
